_comment: MM DayZ server list. The Servers page cards, the Stats page and the automatic stats feed all read this one file, so edit servers here only. Fields per server: id = short unique name used in links and stats files (lowercase, no spaces; do not change once stats exist or history starts fresh). name / map / badge / description / style / slots = text shown on the site (leave style or slots as null to show 'Ask in Discord'). game_port = the port players connect to (null hides the copy button). query_port = the steamQueryPort from that server's serverDZ.cfg, used by the stats feed to check online status and player count (null = skip). cftools_server_api_id = the 'Server ID' from the CFTools Cloud server's API settings, used for leaderboards (null = no leaderboards for this server). color = this server's line colour on the population chart (checked for colour-blind safety, keep these three as they are). restart_hours_utc = hours of the day (0-23, UTC) when the server restarts, used to draw restart markers and the 'next restart' time; leave as [] if unknown. mods = tags shown on the card. image = optional screenshot path, e.g. assets/img/deer-isle.jpg (null shows a placeholder).

servers.name: MM Deer Isle
servers.description: Our longest-running DayZ server. Expansion market and AI, quests, a player-driven economy and our in-house mods.

servers.name: MM Sakhal
servers.description: Survival first: hard but never unfair. Cold, fuel and heat are the real enemy, loot is lean, AI is a genuine threat and long distances are on purpose.

servers.name: MM Badlands
servers.description: Built for the Badlands release on Nasdara. Deer Isle-level difficulty and content, with custom DNA keycard rooms on the way.

hidden_players._comment: Players who asked to be left off public leaderboards and lookup. Add their CFTools ID (from their CFTools profile URL) to the list below; the next stats update removes them.
